name: Steve Feinberg
summary: Steve Feinberg, the billionaire co-founder of Cerberus Capital Management, has been the Pentagon’s No. 2 since March 17, 2025 (confirmed 59–40), running its budget and day-to-day management. In September 2026 Reuters reported the White House had reviewed candidates to replace him over delays in rebuilding munitions stocks; the White House called the report fake news, and Bloomberg Government reported he had won backing from allies to stay.
